text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The venue for the Takarazuka Kinen is filled with many fans who were swayed by her running in the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon steps into the arena for today's G1 race against the backdrop of her cheering fans.
